questions.stem: Transformer Modelsలో Multi-Head Attention అంటే ఏమిటి? One Attention Mechanism బదులు Multiple Heads ఒకే Tokens మధ్య Different Relationshipsని Parallelగా ఎలా Learn చేస్తాయి?
options: Each Head ఒక Word మాత్రమే Choose చేసి Other Token Linksని Permanently Discard చేస్తుంది.
Several Heads Different Token Relationshipsని Parallelగా Learn చేసి Outputs Combine చేస్తాయి.
Unfamiliar Word వచ్చినప్పుడు Each Head Automatically New Vocabulary Tokens Create చేస్తుంది.
Attention Weights Compute కాకముందే All Wordsని Single Vectorగా Merge చేస్తారు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Multiple Heads ఒకే Sentenceని Different Angles నుంచి చూస్తాయి. Head Outputs Combine చేస్తే Richer Context వస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Each Head Has Separate W_Q,W_K,W_V Projections; scaled dot-product attention separately runs. Concatenated Outputs W_Oతో Transform అవుతాయి. Diverse Patterns Possible, Not Guaranteed.

questions.stem: Model Hidden Featuresని Multiple Headsకి Divide చేసి Scaled Dot-Product Attention, Softmax, Concatenation, W_O Projection Mathematically ఎలా Combine చేస్తాం?
options: Every Head Full Hidden Width Keep చేసి Features Splittingని Completely Skip చేస్తుంది.
Heads Features బదులు Sequence Positionsని Split చేసి Attention Calculations Replace చేస్తాయి.
Projected Features Split చేసి Each Head Attend, Concatenate, W_Oతో Transform చేస్తాం.
Raw Queries Average చేసి Learned Output Projection W_Oని Model Permanently Remove చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Hidden Featuresని Smaller Headsగా Split చేస్తాం. Every Head Weights Calculate చేసి Output ఇస్తుంది; W_O Join చేసిన Featuresని Transform చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Standard Equal Headsలో d_head=d_model/H. Every Head Score Matrixపై Softmax, Values Weighted Sum. Concatenate Features, W_O Learned Map Returns d_model Width.

questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Q,K,V[B,H,T,d]. Scores=Q@K.transpose(-2,-1)/√d. Causal Mask Softmax Before Apply చేయాలి; F.scaled_dot_product_attention(...,is_causal=True)తో Compare చేయండి. Dropout Off అవసరం.
questions.figure:
05 · PYTORCH

Split heads, mask the future, compare with built-in attention

Runnable PyTorch example
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

torch.manual_seed(0)
B, T, D, H = 2, 4, 8, 2
x = torch.randn(B, T, D)
W = torch.randn(D, 3 * D)
q, k, v = (x @ W).chunk(3, dim=-1)

def split(t):
    return t.reshape(B, T, H, D // H).transpose(1, 2)

q, k, v = map(split, (q, k, v))
scores = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) / (D // H) ** 0.5
mask = torch.ones(T, T, dtype=torch.bool).tril()
manual = torch.softmax(scores.masked_fill(~mask, -torch.inf), -1) @ v
built_in = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=True)
torch.testing.assert_close(manual, built_in)
print(manual.shape)  # [2, 2, 4, 4]

Swipe sideways to explore the diagram →

The manual implementation and built-in scaled-dot-product attention should match within numerical tolerance.

questions.stem: Some Attention Heads Useful Patterns Learn చేసి Others Redundant ఎందుకు అవుతాయి? Visualization, Entropy, Pruning, Ablation Experiments ఎలా Evaluate చేస్తాయి?
options: Head Attention Maps, Entropy Inspect చేసి Ablationతో Actual Performance Impact Test చేస్తాం.
Trainingలో Each Headకి Fixed Job Assign చేస్తే Redundant Heads Impossible అవుతాయి.
Head Weight Magnitude Only Compare చేస్తే Actual Contribution Perfectగా Know అవుతుంది.
Low-Entropy Head Always Useless కాబట్టి Evaluation లేకుండానే All Remove చేస్తాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Some Heads Repeat Similar Work. Visualization Clues ఇస్తుంది; Head Remove చేసినప్పుడు Task Performance Check చేయడం More Reliable.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Entropy Attention Distribution Concentration Measure చేస్తుంది. Head Pruning/Ablationలో Validation Metric Change Test చేస్తాం; Low Entropy Alone Head Useless అని Prove కాదు.

questions.stem: MHA, MQA, GQA, MLA Architectures Query/KV Sharingలో ఎలా Differ అవుతాయి? KV Cache, FlashAttention, Long-Context Inference Efficiencyని ఎలా Improve చేస్తాయి?
options: MHA, MQAలో All Query Heads KV Sharing Exactly Same విధంగా జరుగుతుంది.
MLA Past Token Context Store చేయదు; Generationకి Cache Completely Unnecessary అవుతుంది.
FlashAttention All Long Sequencesపై Exact Dense Attention Compute Linearగా Reduces చేస్తుంది.
MQA Shares KV; GQA Groups Queries; MLA Compresses KV; FlashAttention IO Optimize చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: MQA/GQA/MLA Cached KV Memory Reduce చేస్తాయి. FlashAttention Memory Transfers Optimize చేస్తుంది, కానీ Long Context Still Computational Cost ఉంటుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. MHA Separate KV per Query Head; MQA One Shared KV Head; GQA Grouped KV; MLA Compressed Latent Cache. KV Reuse Generation Memory Save చేస్తుంది; FlashAttention IO-Aware Exact Dense Attentionతో Traffic Reduce చేస్తుంది, Quadratic Arithmetic Remove కాదు.
